headline: Clinton order changes the rules for the Armed Forces Reserve Medal, an award given to members of the military reserves.
what_it_does: This executive order amends Executive Order 10163, an earlier order that created the Armed Forces Reserve Medal. The medal honors service in the reserve parts of the US armed forces. No summary was provided, so the exact changes to who can earn the medal or how it is awarded are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the military reserves and National Guard
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules for the medal that recognizes their reserve service, though the specific changes are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 6, 1996; no separate effective date was provided.
